about_the_game:
Titan of industry Nathaniel Walker has been suddenly ousted from his leadership position at the cargo transportation company Atlas Walker. You have been brought on as the new Operational Director and are now in charge of its day-to-day operations.

While you may still be learning the ropes, the waters of the world continue to churn turbulently around you. You must adapt and continue to ensure the smooth sailing of the company. Will you rise to the challenge or flounder?

As Operational Director, you will be in charge of the day-to-day logistics of the Atlas Walker company. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that the company maintains positive cash flow while balancing its global reputation. 

Tasks of utmost importance include:

  • Route vessels around the world to transport cargo

  • Distribute natural resources to factories

  • Manufacture refined resources

  • Maintain and upgrade your fleet

  • Adapt to meet the challenges of current global events

  • Uphold a positive company reputation with the world and with company contacts

Your choices matter. The decisions you make as an ambassador of Atlas Walker make waves around the entire globe!

The world of Unfathomable Titans comes alive with fully voiced, narrative questlines to supplement the strategic gameplay. Branching storylines unfold like episodes in an ongoing TV show, and they evolve depending on the paths you choose. 

Who will you show allegiance to? - Your decisions will ripple forward and shape character relationships, affect global reputation, unlock new opportunities, and help skyrocket Atlas Walker to unfathomable success. Each playthrough of Unfathomable Titans tells a different story.

Will you run the company by the book? Or will you take a more nefarious approach? As Operational Director, you must balance people pleasing and company prowess.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A turn-of-the-century transportation management game in which you control the world's largest cargo shipping company. Connect ports, deliver cargo, cultivate relationships, and adapt your business all while trying to avoid getting fired.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
